nice burger to go with the band
Jan 2019
a top venue for some Friday night rock and roll. The room is great and full of motorbike paraphernalia- even the ashtrays outside are from cylinders. No smoking inside the room but plenty of seating outside in the delightful beer garden. The menu is purely western with burgers, ribs and share plates. Our group had a couple of bacon and cheese burgers plus the bbq seafood plate- came with a couple of hoegardens - very nice! Servings were adequate, well cooked and professionally presented. The menu is not huge but you will find something to satisfy your taste buds- not cheap but OK value. Its located down an alleyway which opens up nicely - the place was packed the night we went so suggest you book.

OMG! So glad to stumble on this place!
Jan 2018 • Family
We stumbled across this place looking for some street food down a dark, but bustling alleyway, and were not disappointed! The prices certainly aren't that of street food, but the food was extraordinary.
It definitely leans toward western food, but the flavours are nothing like we would have at home. 
I had the beef banh mi, which was supposed to be chicken, but I'm not fussy, I really love banh mi! Soon good!!!!!
We were all extremely happy with our individual meals, and the service was great. 
We were speaking to the owner for a fair while and he was telling us how, and why, he set up the place. Such a nice man, and very friendly and amenable. A very interesting story.
If you can find Biker Shield, tucked down an alley, under an archway, off Nguyen Cong Tru in District 1, you will not regret it.
